To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of surge capacity is an effective way to reduce wait times in the healthcare system; (2) the optimal use of surge capacity depends on the relative priorities of patients and the cost of surge capacity; (3) OR methods can be applied to healthcare management to improve wait times; (4) a Markov decision process can be used to optimize the use of surge; and (5) simulation can be used to evaluate the impact of surge capacity on the entire healthcare system
by applying OR methods to healthcare management, we can: • Identify the causes of long wait times and quantify the effect of capacity on the wait time distribution.

(a) the use of OR methods can help managers to reduce wait times and (b) OR methods can be applied to the problem of scheduling patients with multiple priorities, and can help to determine how to optimally use surge capacity.
